name: Bridges to Prosperity footbridges
description: Footbridges in rural areas that connect isolated households to schools, clinics, and markets.
why_it_works: A bridge removes a physical barrier, so every trip to school, a clinic, or a market becomes shorter and safer.

name: Chlorine vouchers
description: Vouchers that households redeem for free chlorine to treat their drinking water.
why_it_works: The voucher removes the price of chlorine, which is one reason households do not treat water.

name: Community-based household contact management programs for tuberculosis
description: Health workers visit the homes of people diagnosed with TB, screen close contacts, and give preventive medicine where appropriate.
why_it_works: People who share a home with a TB patient have high exposure, so the search starts where new cases are most likely.

name: Community-based management of acute malnutrition
description: Outpatient identification and treatment of uncomplicated severe and moderate acute malnutrition.
why_it_works: Outpatient treatment is designed to reach more children than hospital care, because families do not have to stay at a hospital.

name: Conditional cash transfers to increase infant vaccination as run by New Incentives
description: Cash to caregivers who bring infants for routine vaccinations, plus outreach and work to keep vaccines in stock at clinics.
why_it_works: Clinic visits cost caregivers time and money. A small payment at each visit offsets part of that cost.

name: Deworming (mass drug administration targeting schistosomiasis and/or soil-transmitted helminths)
description: Anti-parasitic drugs for all school-age children in at-risk areas, once or twice a year.
why_it_works: Where worm infections are common, treating everyone costs less than testing each child, and schools gather children in one place.

name: Electronic immunization registry and mobile-based conditional cash transfers to increase vaccination as run by IRD Global
description: Conditional cash transfers through a mobile-phone platform to encourage infant immunization in low-coverage districts.

name: Eyeglasses to improve workers' manual dexterity
description: Free or subsidized eyeglasses for workers whose output depends on close manual work.
why_it_works: Near vision declines with age. Glasses let a worker keep doing precise work at full speed.

name: Family planning radio campaigns
description: Radio campaigns that aim to increase the use of modern contraception.
why_it_works: One broadcast reaches many listeners at a very low cost per person.

name: Intermittent preventive treatment in infants (IPTi) for malaria
description: Preventive antimalarial medicine for young infants, given at routine vaccination visits.

name: Iron fortification
description: Iron added to staple foods, such as wheat flour, to reduce iron deficiency.
why_it_works: People eat staple foods every day, so fortification reaches them without any change in behavior.

name: Iron supplementation for school-age children
description: Iron supplements for school-age children to prevent anemia.
why_it_works: Schools give regular access to children, so a weekly supplement is easy to deliver.

name: Kangaroo mother care (KMC)
description: A low-cost alternative to neonatal intensive care for low-birthweight babies during their stay at a health facility.
why_it_works: Continuous skin-to-skin contact keeps a small baby warm and supports feeding when incubators are scarce.

name: Malaria vaccine
description: The RTS,S malaria vaccine for young children in moderate-to-high transmission areas, as part of wider malaria control.
why_it_works: The vaccine trains the immune system to attack the parasite early in an infection.

name: Mass distribution of long-lasting insecticide-treated nets
description: Long-lasting insecticide-treated nets for everyone in malaria-risk areas, usually every three years.
why_it_works: Malaria mosquitoes bite mostly at night. The net is a barrier, and the insecticide kills mosquitoes that land on it.

name: One Acre Fund's tree program
description: Tree seedlings and training for small-scale farmers.
why_it_works: Trees are a slow-growing asset. Farmers can later sell the timber or use it themselves.

name: Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) and zinc supplementation
description: Treatment of dehydration from diarrhea with a glucose-and-salt solution, plus a short course of zinc.
why_it_works: Diarrhea kills mainly through dehydration. ORS replaces the lost fluid and salts.

name: Participatory Learning and Action - Maternal and Neonatal Health
description: Facilitated groups of women, especially pregnant women, who develop local plans to improve care-seeking and prevention for mothers and newborns.
why_it_works: The group finds its own local problems and solutions, which can make the changes easier to keep.

name: Ponseti casting for clubfoot
description: Treatment for clubfoot: a series of casts to correct the foot, a small tendon procedure, and then bracing.
why_it_works: Early correction lets a child walk normally and prevents a lifelong disability.

name: Seasonal malaria chemoprevention
description: Monthly courses of antimalarial medicine for children under 5 during the peak transmission season.
why_it_works: Where malaria is concentrated in a few months each year, drugs given only in that window protect children when risk is highest.

name: SMS reminders for immunization
description: Text messages that remind caregivers of their children's upcoming vaccination dates.
why_it_works: Many caregivers intend to vaccinate but forget the date. A reminder at the right time costs very little.

name: Syphilis screening and treatment during pregnancy
description: Rapid point-of-care syphilis testing and treatment during pregnancy.
why_it_works: Treatment during pregnancy prevents transmission to the baby, so a cheap test at the first visit protects two people.

name: Vitamin A supplementation
description: High-dose vitamin A for children aged about 6 months to 5 years in high-risk areas, two or three times a year.
why_it_works: Vitamin A deficiency weakens the immune system. A periodic high dose tops up a child's stores.

name: Water quality interventions
description: Removal or disabling of pathogens in water, for example with chlorine dispensers or in-line chlorination.
why_it_works: Treatment at the water source protects everyone who collects water there, without effort from each household.

name: Family planning commodities
description: Distribution of family planning commodities.
why_it_works: Stockouts mean that women who want contraception cannot get it. A reliable supply closes that gap.

name: Breastfeeding promotion
description: Counseling, community work, and media that encourage mothers to breastfeed exclusively and for longer.
givewell_view: GiveWell calls the program promising and may look for funding opportunities in some contexts.
why_it_works: Breast milk gives nutrition and protection from infection, and clean water is not necessary.

name: Cash transfers
description: Cash grants to poor people in low-income countries.
givewell_view: GiveWell supported GiveDirectly from 2012 to 2022 and updated its assessment in 2024; it is now funding scoping of program variations.
why_it_works: Households know their own needs. Cash lets them buy, invest, or repay what matters most to them.

name: Chlorhexidine for umbilical cord care
description: An antiseptic applied to the newborn's umbilical cord stump to prevent infection.
givewell_view: GiveWell finds it promising in some circumstances and plans more research.
why_it_works: The cord stump is an open route for bacteria in the first days of life. An antiseptic closes that route.

name: Community-based intervention packages to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality
description: Care for women and newborns through community outreach workers, such as warmth after birth, breastfeeding help, vitamin K, and referrals.
givewell_view: GiveWell still wants to find a promising program of this type.

name: Facility-based maternal and neonatal health interventions
description: Training for health workers to deliver a package of care during and after birth in health facilities.
givewell_view: GiveWell finds it promising but is highly uncertain about specific programs, so it may attach an evaluation to any grant.
why_it_works: Many deaths happen around birth. Better-trained staff at that moment can act on complications fast.

name: Mass distribution of azithromycin to reduce child mortality
description: An antibiotic given to all children in an age range, once or twice a year.
givewell_view: GiveWell's review found it may be cost-effective enough, but it is studying implementation and the risk of antibiotic resistance.
why_it_works: A mass dose clears many common infections at once, including ones that are not yet diagnosed.

name: Probiotic supplementation for preterm newborns
description: Probiotic supplements for small or preterm newborns to prevent necrotizing enterocolitis and sepsis.
givewell_view: GiveWell finds it promising and wants to learn about implementation opportunities.

name: Sayana® Press
description: An injectable contraceptive in a prefilled single-use device that community health workers or women themselves can give.
givewell_view: GiveWell finds it promising and plans more research.

name: Targeting the Ultra Poor
description: Productive assets such as livestock for very poor households, with mentoring, training, and other support.
givewell_view: GiveWell continues to look for programs of this type that are cost-effective and need funding.
why_it_works: Very poor households often face several constraints at once. The bundle tries to relax all of them together.

name: Attractive toxic sugar baits for malaria control
description: Sugar mixed with a substance lethal to mosquitoes, used to reduce mosquito populations.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence; GiveWell expects new evidence.

name: Community health promoters as run by Living Goods
description: Promoters who sell health and household goods door to door and give basic health advice.
givewell_view: GiveWell will revisit when results of a larger-scale trial are available.
why_it_works: A local promoter lowers the distance to basic care and products, and sales help pay for the work.

name: Community salt substitution
description: Table salt replaced for a whole community by a substitute in which potassium chloride replaces part of the sodium.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is that it is below its funding bar; it will revisit when a stroke study is published.
why_it_works: Less sodium and more potassium lower blood pressure, and people do not have to change what they cook.

name: Eave tubes to control malaria
description: Tubes with insecticide-treated netting installed in the gap between roof and walls to kill mosquitoes as they pass.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence; GiveWell expects new evidence.

name: Educate! Experience program
description: Mentoring for students in their last two years of secondary school, with a focus on leadership, work readiness, and entrepreneurship.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence; GiveWell expects new evidence.
why_it_works: Skills that school often does not teach may help young people find work or start a business.

name: Electronic partogram
description: Help for health facilities to move from paper to electronic partograms to track and manage labor.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence; GiveWell expects new evidence.

name: HPV vaccination to prevent cervical cancer
description: HPV vaccination for girls aged 9 to 14 to prevent cervical cancer.
givewell_view: GiveWell believed in 2020 that there were probably no large funding gaps, because vaccine supply was the constraint.
why_it_works: Vaccination before exposure prevents the infection that causes most cervical cancer.

name: Antenatal corticosteroids for pregnant women at risk of preterm birth
description: Corticosteroids for women at 24 to 34 weeks of pregnancy who are at risk of preterm birth.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because trial results differ and harm is possible; GiveWell awaits an ongoing trial.

name: Antiretroviral therapy to treat HIV/AIDS
description: Ongoing antiretroviral drugs for people living with HIV to reduce illness and extend life.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is that it is below its cost-effectiveness bar.
why_it_works: The drugs suppress the virus, which keeps the immune system working.

name: Artemisia tea
description: Malaria treatment with a tea made from Artemisia plants.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after a shallow look at the evidence.

name: Aspirin for cardiovascular disease prevention
description: Aspirin for people at risk of cardiovascular disease, to reduce heart attacks and strokes.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate and few visible funding opportunities.

name: Bracelets for immunization
description: Colored bracelets for infants that show immunization status, as a social signal.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on cost-effectiveness and on thin evidence outside the original setting.
why_it_works: A visible bracelet reminds parents of the next dose and shows neighbors who is up to date.

name: Bt eggplant adoption
description: Support for farmers to adopt eggplant that is genetically modified to be toxic to a major pest.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate and limited room for funding.
why_it_works: A crop that resists its main pest needs less spraying and loses less of the harvest.

name: Cataract surgery
description: Surgery that removes a clouded eye lens and replaces it with an artificial lens.
givewell_view: GiveWell could not find strong evidence that charity activity increases the number of surgeries.
why_it_works: A short operation can restore sight that would otherwise be lost for life.

name: Clean cookstoves
description: Stoves designed to reduce indoor smoke compared with open fires that burn wood or dung.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after GiveWell assessed the evidence of effectiveness.
why_it_works: Less smoke in the home means less exposure to air pollution for the people who cook and the children near them.

name: Community distribution of polypill for cardiovascular disease prevention
description: One pill with fixed doses of several drugs to reduce cardiovascular risk, distributed in the community.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.

name: Community-based antibiotic delivery for possible serious bacterial infection (PSBI) management
description: Home-based antibiotics for newborns with suspected serious infection when a hospital referral is not possible.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because evidence on community delivery alone is lacking.

name: Conditional subsidies for seasonal labor migration in northern Bangladesh
description: Cash or interest-free loans that help rural workers migrate for work during the lean season.
givewell_view: GiveWell supported this from 2014 to 2019, then deprioritized it after newer evidence.
why_it_works: In the lean season there is little local work. A small subsidy covers the risk and the fare of a trip to find jobs elsewhere.

name: Condom promotion and distribution to prevent HIV/AIDS
description: Education and advertising for condom use, and free or subsidized condoms.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after GiveWell assessed the evidence of effectiveness.
why_it_works: Condoms block transmission, so easier access can reduce new infections.

name: Cryptococcal antigen testing for people living with HIV
description: Diagnosis and treatment of a deadly fungal infection, mainly among people living with HIV.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because cost-effective room for funding seems lacking.

name: Deworming pregnant people
description: A single preventive deworming dose for pregnant people to reduce infections that contribute to anemia.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because GiveWell expects few funding opportunities.

name: Diagnosis and treatment for chronic pulmonary aspergillosis
description: Diagnosis and treatment of a deadly fungal infection, mainly among people with structural lung disease.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on limited evidence in low-resource settings and hard implementation.

name: Diagnosis and treatment for disseminated histoplasmosis
description: Diagnosis and treatment of a deadly fungal infection, mainly among people living with HIV.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on shallow cost-effectiveness and funding-room estimates.

name: Diagnosis and treatment for pneumocystis pneumonia
description: Diagnosis and treatment of a deadly fungal infection, mainly among people living with HIV.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow look at evidence and cost-effectiveness.

name: Distribution of eyeglasses to improve academic performance
description: Free or subsidized glasses for students with poor vision, to improve school performance.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on the evidence; GiveWell rates the evidence for glasses for workers more highly.
why_it_works: A child who cannot see the board cannot learn from it.

name: Early childhood psychosocial stimulation
description: Training for parents to support development through play and other activities, to build cognitive and language skills.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on evidence and cost-effectiveness.
why_it_works: The brain develops fastest in the first years, so small changes in daily play can have large effects.

name: Education in developing countries
description: A wide range of programs that aim to improve education.
givewell_view: Deprioritized as a category on the evidence; GiveWell may look at single education programs later.

name: Eggs for complementary feeding
description: Chicken eggs given to families to feed to infants alongside breast milk.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.
why_it_works: Eggs are a compact source of protein and micronutrients at the age when growth falters.

name: Generic hepatitis C medication
description: Generic direct-acting antivirals to treat hepatitis C.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.

name: Immunization to prevent meningitis A
description: Immunization campaigns against meningitis A to prevent deaths, brain damage, and hearing loss.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on room for more funding.
why_it_works: Campaigns vaccinate many people at once and can stop a disease that spreads in epidemics.

name: Integrated community case management
description: Community health workers trained and supplied to treat simple pneumonia, malaria, and diarrhea.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after GiveWell assessed the evidence of effectiveness.
why_it_works: Treatment close to home comes sooner, and these illnesses kill quickly when treatment is late.

name: Intermittent preventive treatment of malaria during pregnancy
description: Antimalarial drugs for at-risk pregnant women in the second and third trimesters.
givewell_view: GiveWell found low cost-effectiveness and weak evidence.

name: Interventions to promote handwashing
description: Education and/or materials such as soap to promote handwashing.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on evidence and cost-effectiveness.
why_it_works: Soap removes pathogens from hands before they reach food or mouths.

name: Larval source management for malaria control
description: Methods that kill mosquitoes at the larval stage, such as habitat changes, larvicide on water, and biological control.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence; GiveWell expects new evidence.

name: Lymphoedema management to prevent acute adenolymphangitis in podoconiosis
description: Education and supplies such as bandages and shoes for people with podoconiosis, to reduce acute attacks.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.

name: Magnesium sulfate for preeclampsia
description: Wider availability of magnesium sulfate to prevent eclampsia in people with severe preeclampsia.
givewell_view: GiveWell thinks broad programs are likely below its cost-effectiveness range.

name: Malaria rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs)
description: Rapid tests to reduce overprescription of antimalarials and to find other causes of fever.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for lack of evidence that the tests reduce deaths.

name: Manual water pumps for farming households
description: Manual pumps for smallholder farmers to irrigate crops when rainfall is low.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.

name: Mass media to promote behavior change as run by Development Media International
description: Radio and television programs that encourage better health practices.
givewell_view: GiveWell sees limited evidence, based on a trial of the child-mortality program.
why_it_works: One broadcast reaches a whole region at a very low cost per listener.

name: Mass screen-and-treatment programs for tuberculosis
description: TB testing for everyone above an age threshold, and treatment for people with the disease.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is below its bar, but it is uncertain about costs, feasibility, and differences by place.
why_it_works: Many people with TB do not know they have it. Finding them early stops them infecting others.

name: Microfinance
description: Loans and other financial services, such as savings or insurance, for poor people.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after GiveWell assessed the evidence of effectiveness.
why_it_works: The theory: small businesses have high returns to capital but cannot borrow from banks.

name: Micronutrient powders
description: Packets of vitamins and minerals that families add to children's food.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.

name: Neonatal vitamin A supplementation (NVAS)
description: A large dose of vitamin A for infants shortly after birth.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on evidence and limited room for funding.

name: Non-pneumatic anti-shock garments
description: A compression garment that stabilizes women with postpartum hemorrhage until they get treatment.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on room for more funding.

name: Oral ivermectin mass drug administration for scabies control
description: Oral ivermectin for almost everyone in a scabies-affected community.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on cost-effectiveness and room for funding.
why_it_works: Scabies spreads by close contact, so everyone is treated at once to stop reinfection.

name: Oral Pre-exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) for HIV
description: Antiretroviral drugs for HIV-negative people to prevent infection.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on cost-effectiveness.
why_it_works: The drugs block the virus before it can take hold.

name: Polio eradication activities
description: Support for polio vaccination in endemic countries and related work elsewhere.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.
why_it_works: If transmission stops everywhere, the disease is gone and no future vaccination is necessary.

name: Post-discharge malaria chemoprevention (PDMC) for children with severe anemia
description: Antimalarials for children after hospital treatment for severe anemia.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because GiveWell sees limited funding opportunities.

name: Precision Development (PxD)
description: Locally tailored agricultural advice sent to farmers' mobile phones.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is below its bar with limited evidence, though more work could change that.
why_it_works: A text or voice message can deliver timely advice to many farmers at almost no cost per farmer.

name: Probiotics for gestational diabetes
description: Probiotics for pregnant women with gestational diabetes.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for limited evidence.

name: Programs to increase the supply of midwives
description: Support to add midwives where maternal and newborn care workers are too few.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on low estimated cost-effectiveness and a lack of direct evidence.

name: Prophylactic antibiotics to reduce infections from caesarean sections
description: Preventive antibiotics for women who deliver by caesarean section.
givewell_view: Deprioritized because GiveWell expects few funding opportunities.

name: Rapid diagnostic tests and drug therapy for visceral leishmaniasis in East Africa
description: Screening and treatment for a tropical disease common in East Africa.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on limited room for funding.

name: Safe birth kits for pregnant people
description: Kits for pregnant people to reduce the risk of maternal or newborn death.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on low estimated cost-effectiveness.

name: School feeding programs
description: Meals at school to reduce malnutrition, remove barriers to attendance, and help learning.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.
why_it_works: A free meal gives nutrition and also a reason for families to send children to school.

name: Selenium supplementation for neonatal sepsis prevention
description: Selenium supplements for very low birthweight infants to prevent sepsis.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for limited evidence.

name: Small-quantity lipid nutrient supplementation
description: Lipid-based nutrient supplements for children to prevent malnutrition.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on low estimated cost-effectiveness.

name: Soft skills certification
description: Certificates for non-cognitive skills, such as trustworthiness, that workers can show to employers.
givewell_view: Deprioritized after GiveWell assessed the evidence of effectiveness.
why_it_works: Employers cannot see soft skills directly. A credible certificate lets good workers prove them.

name: StrongMinds
description: Group interpersonal psychotherapy for women with depression.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is below other programs it funds, with a wide range of uncertainty.
why_it_works: Groups let one trained facilitator treat many people and add peer support.

name: Supplementary immunization activities to prevent measles
description: Find gaps in measles coverage through surveys or surveillance, and run campaigns in at-risk areas.
givewell_view: Deprioritized for a lack of cost-effective room for funding.

name: Surgery to repair obstetric fistula
description: Surgery to repair an abnormal opening after childbirth that causes leakage of urine or feces.
givewell_view: GiveWell's best guess is below its bar, with major open questions.
why_it_works: Repair ends a condition that often causes isolation, and one operation can fix it.

name: Targeted azithromycin distribution for children being discharged from the hospital
description: A course of antibiotics at hospital discharge for children who were recently severely ill.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on limited global room for funding.

name: Unconditional cash transfers during pregnancy and when children are very young
description: Cash transfers to women during pregnancy and early childhood as a household income stream.
givewell_view: Deprioritized on a shallow cost-effectiveness estimate.
why_it_works: Money at this time can pay for food and care when needs are highest.
